title: Open Logic Project — Hindi Working Edition (158 of 722 Source Files)
description: A 211-page searchable Hindi (hi-Deva-IN) working reader assembled from exactly 158 accepted frozen-source TeX files representing 59,955 source words. Editable sources, matching frozen English witnesses, complete relevant provenance, failures, build and rendered-page QA, and checksums accompany the reader. This is not a completed 722-file translation, human review, peer review, critical edition, or PDF/UA certification.
